source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
scope: Year 1 Unit 2 Let's Play! SB22-33; verified visual scan guidance

guidance.aims: Present toy vocabulary and practise listening, pointing and naming.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use the opening unit scene to identify toys, play the vocabulary recording for pupils to point and repeat, then recycle the words through short pair questions.
guidance.checking_feedback: Check recognition by pointing to different toys in random order and eliciting names.
guidance.extension_optional: Use real toys or picture cards for a quick memory/guessing game.

guidance.aims: Practise toy vocabulary through a song and personal response.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use the unit song on SB p23: establish the scene, listen for toy words, replay for repetition and singing, then personalise with pupils' favourite toys.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pupils to identify the toy words heard and compare responses in pairs.
guidance.extension_optional: Groups substitute familiar toy words into the song pattern.

guidance.aims: Develop listening discrimination and description of toys.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p24 listen and number the toy pictures, then use the monster/guessing task to practise describing and identifying items.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare numbering before replay/class checking; monitor descriptive exchanges.
guidance.extension_optional: Pupils draw a toy/monster and challenge a partner to identify it from a short description.

guidance.aims: Follow the go-kart picture story and recycle unit language.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Preview the story pictures, elicit predictions, play/read the story, pause to check events and characters, then replay/read for sequence and role practice.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pupils to order key events and identify who says selected lines.
guidance.ending_lesson: Groups take roles and perform a shortened version of the story.

guidance.aims: Consolidate the story and practise key language from the go-kart episode.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Revisit the story, use the follow-up pictures/tasks to check understanding, then practise target phrases orally in pairs.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs justify answers using story evidence before whole-class feedback.
guidance.extension_optional: Retell the story using a small set of picture prompts.

guidance.aims: Develop reading for specific information about toys.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Read the short toy descriptions on SB p27, number/match the go-karts and use the text to identify specific features.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pupils compare matches in pairs and point to the words that support each answer.
guidance.extension_optional: Write one new short toy description for a partner to match.

guidance.aims: Practise reading and checking descriptions of familiar toys.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p28 look and read, then mark each statement true/false according to the pictures; follow with oral correction of false statements.
guidance.checking_feedback: Require pupils to correct each false sentence rather than only give a cross.
guidance.extension_optional: Pairs create one true and one false statement about another toy picture.

guidance.aims: Integrate listening, speaking and writing around favourite toys.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Listen and write children's names under the correct toys, ask/answer about favourite toys, then draw and write a short description of a favourite toy.
guidance.checking_feedback: Compare listening answers in pairs; check that written descriptions correspond to pupils' drawings.
guidance.extension_optional: Display drawings and let classmates guess the toy from the description.

guidance.aims: Integrate Mathematics/shape vocabulary through a tangram task.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Identify and name the shapes, read the short information about tangrams, identify missing shapes, then discuss how shapes combine to make pictures.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pupils to name both the shape and its position when checking.
guidance.extension_optional: Make a simple tangram picture and describe the shapes used.

guidance.aims: Complete a hands-on tangram project using English instructions.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Follow the project sequence to make a tangram, use the pieces to create a picture and describe the result to a partner.
guidance.checking_feedback: Monitor pupils' ability to follow the sequence and name shapes while constructing.
guidance.extension_optional: Partners exchange tangram pictures and try to recreate each other's design.

guidance.aims: Use imagination and oral language to create and present a picture.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Listen/imagine from the prompt, draw an individual picture, then show it to a partner and describe what was created.
guidance.checking_feedback: Partners listen for key unit vocabulary and ask a simple follow-up question.
guidance.extension_optional: Create a small class gallery and let pupils describe another pupil's picture.

guidance.aims: Review Unit 2 language and reflect on learning.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use the final unit review/reflection activities to recycle toys, descriptions and shapes, then have pupils identify what they can now say/read/write.
guidance.checking_feedback: Use pair review followed by quick whole-class retrieval of unit vocabulary.
guidance.ending_lesson: Pupils state or write one thing they learnt and one activity they enjoyed.
guidance.extension_optional: Repeat a favourite Unit 2 game using the verified vocabulary.
